text: yara: quick usability spike: when panels are narrow our axis ticks switch to compact SI units and legend items wrap. users in research got confused about exact values. sharing a mock. matt: can you drop the link or frame id? yara: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123 7 shows compact axis (1.2M) with legend wrapping; variant shows full numbers but pushes the entire grid. added a per-chart smoothing toggle in the header. sam: prefer compact numbers visually, but we must make exact values reachable. keyboard-first approach: numbers should be focusable and reveal a persistent tooltip on focus (not hover-only). aria-label should include spelled-out numbers. priya: agree. micro-accessibility example I like: ``` 1.23M ``` no role="img" on numerics. matt: outlier handling: current mock dims outliers by lowering opacity. that hides important spikes. alternative: cap y-axis at a percentile (default 99) and render a short dashed extension for clipped spikes plus a small overflow badge at chart top-right. clicking badge opens an inline drawer with full values. yara: visual direction: dashed stub + small "+" badge with aria-label seems discoverable. copy for badge action: "View full range". sam: wording vote: react with :+1: for "View full range", :thinking_face: for other ideas. priya: accessibility nit: badge must be role="button" with aria-expanded toggling state and aria-labelledby pointing to a hidden SR-only element that spells the clipped value. example snippet: value clipped: twelve million three hundred forty-five thousand. matt: perf note: only draw dashed extensions for series that exceed cap; batch when multiple series clipped. also avoid re-layout on legend wrap by keeping legend truncated to one line with ellipsis and a focusable tooltip. yara: legend header copy: prefer "Series" over "Metrics" (shorter). add a tiny "Show all" affordance to expand the legend into multi-line for power users. sam: smoothing toggle: default OFF for fidelity. persist per-dashboard in localStorage first, then hook up to saved views API. priya: QA checklist for a11y: 1) compact numbers focusable + SR spelled-out 2) overflow badge keyboard accessible + announces exact clipped value 3) inline drawer contains textual table of full values 4) legend items focusable + tooltip on focus 5) smoothing toggle reachable via keyboard and persists. yara: action items: 1) design: mock dashed stub + "+" overflow badge + inline drawer (yara) 2) design/dev: single-line legend with ellipsis + focusable tooltip, "Show all" expand (matt) 3) dev: aria-label pattern for compact numbers + localStorage smoothing toggle (sam) 4) copy: use "View full range" for badge text (priya) figma-bot: uploaded image 1819990012 (compact-axis-badge.png) yara: i'll upload updated frames by EOD and tag for quick a11y review. thanks! :sparkles:
